## What this is

<!--
An ADR captures a design decision. This issue's body becomes the source
content of `.agents/adr/NNNN-<slug>.md`. When the ADR is accepted, the file is
added (or updated) in the same pull request that closes this issue.
-->

**Status (in this issue):** <Proposed / Accepted / Superseded>

**Affects:** <one line: what does this decision change?>

## Context

<!--
The situation that forced a decision. What were the options? What did the
measurements say? A decision without its context cannot be reviewed by
someone who was not there.
-->

## Options considered

| Option | Consequence |
|---|---|
| A | |
| B | |

## Decision

<!--
The choice, in one sentence, plus the reasoning that is not obvious from the
choice itself.
-->

## Consequences

<!--
What becomes easier, what becomes harder, and what has to change elsewhere.
-->

## Verification

<!--
How the next person can tell that this decision is being followed. A rule
that only lives in a document will be broken by accident.
-->
